about:
Cable Components Inc operates from Sussex, Wisconsin, supplying electrical and solar power components through an online catalog. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed on its website.

The firm distributes a range of products including Heyco strain reliefs, bushings, grommets, and venting solutions; Staubli MC4 solar connectors, branch connectors, and crimping tooling; SolaDeck photovoltaic junction boxes and kits; Caplugs protective plugs, caps, and connector covers; Bumper Specialties rubber bumpers in hemispherical, cylindrical, and square profiles; Gripmaster insulated and all-metal strain reliefs; TechFlex braided sleeving and wrap; and Sealcon liquid-tight strain relief connectors. It offers value-added services such as cut-to-length tubing, same- or next-day shipping on stocked items, and no minimum line-order requirements.

Customers span the solar energy, electrical contracting, electronics assembly, and general industrial sectors. The catalog serves buyers seeking component-level parts for photovoltaic installations, wire management, and equipment protection.

The company emphasizes rapid fulfillment and flexible ordering, promoting same-day dispatch, low purchase-order minimums, and non-standard color options on select bushings and plugs as key differentiators.
